newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tung Fong Hung mulls sale of Nam Pei Hong.
newsitem.headline: Tung Fong Hung mulls sale of Nam Pei Hong.

text.p: Chinese medicines retailer Tung Fong Hung (Holdings) Ltd said in a statement on Thursday that an independent third party was interested in buying its entire holding in Nam Pei Hong (Holdings) Ltd.
Tung Fong Hung, which holds about 29.09 percent of Nam Pei Hong, said the approach by the third party was preliminary and no binding agreement has been entered into.
"Shareholders and investors should be aware that the disposal may or may not proceed," it said.
Nam Pei Hong is also a retailer of Chinese medicines and a health foods retailer and manufacturer. Its shares rose HK$0.065 or 13.4 percent to end at HK$0.55 each on Wednesday.
